1a6debd1: In which city is Friends set?
Friends is set in New York (Manhattan): Central Perk and the apartments are in Greenwich Village. The series was shot on studio sets in Burbank, California.
e95d21aa: What is the name of the iconic coffee house where the six friends meet?
Central Perk is the iconic coffee house where the six friends gather on the big orange couch. Gunther, the barista secretly in love with Rachel, works there throughout the series.
149a5689: Who says the legendary line “We were on a break!”?
Ross says “We were on a break!” after his night with Chloe, the copy-place girl, during his split from Rachel. The running gag lasts the whole series as his ultimate excuse.
03e1f0c4: Monica is a professional chef. She works in several restaurants over the series.
8e4f67fc: Matt LeBlanc plays Joey Tribbiani, a struggling actor and incorrigible ladies' man who never stops eating and lives with Chandler. His character got his own spin-off, Joey (2004-2006).
a32e15c3: What is Rachel's famous haircut in the early seasons called?
“The Rachel” is Jennifer Aniston's layered cut from the early seasons, which became the most requested haircut in 1990s salons.
e4e89533: How many seasons does Friends have?
Friends has 10 seasons, aired from 1994 to 2004 on NBC, for 236 episodes in total. The finale was watched by 52.5 million American viewers.
d2462f54: What is the running gag about Chandler's job?
Nobody knows exactly what he does
Nobody, not even his friends, really understands what Chandler does for a living: they can never explain his job, something to do with statistical analysis and data.
e8d10218: Which character says “OH. MY. GOD.” with a piercing laugh?
Janice (Maggie Wheeler), with her piercing laugh and her “OH. MY. GOD.”, is one of the most memorable supporting characters: Chandler's ex who always turns up at the worst moment.
3e82dae3: Who is Monica's childhood best friend?
Rachel Green is Monica's childhood best friend. They reunite when Rachel runs away from her wedding to Barry and turns up at Monica's door without a penny.
0388fd01: In which iconic episode does Ross shout “PIVOT!”?
The One Where No One's Ready
The One with All the Rugby
“The One with the Cop” (season 5): Ross, Chandler and Rachel try to carry a couch up a narrow staircase, and Ross keeps shouting “PIVOT!” in a now legendary sequence.
90b8e607: What is the name of the character Joey plays on Days of Our Lives?
Dr. Drake Ramoray is the famous neurosurgeon Joey plays on Days of Our Lives. The character dies, comes back with someone else's brain and carries on his comic adventures.
93de517d: Ross and Rachel have a big ceremony
Monica and Chandler move to the suburbs, Ross and Rachel get back together
Phoebe and Mike get married in the finale
Joey stays single and moves to Los Angeles
In the finale, Ross and Rachel get back together, their relationship being the series' common thread. Monica and Chandler leave with their twins for the suburbs.
baccfaf3: Which song does Phoebe sing at Central Perk with her guitar?
“Smelly Cat” is Phoebe's signature song, an absurd tune about a foul-smelling cat that she regularly sings at Central Perk. It even gets its own music video in the series.
ad1aa20c: In which episode does Ross dress up as an armadillo to celebrate Hanukkah with his son?
The One with Christmas in Tulsa
The One with the Holiday Armadillo
“The One with the Holiday Armadillo” (season 7): Ross wants to teach his son Ben about Hanukkah but can only find an armadillo costume. Chandler shows up as Santa, Joey as Superman.
7f220518: How many times has Ross been married?
Ross has been married three times: to Carol (who comes out as a lesbian), to Emily (a disastrous wedding where he says Rachel's name), and briefly to Rachel in Las Vegas after a wild night.
de7105f6: What is the first name of Ross and Carol's son?
Ben is Ross and Carol's son. He is born during the first season and raised by Carol and her partner Susan.
55a6ad97: Matthew Perry plays Chandler Bing. He died in October 2023 and is deeply missed. Chandler, with his defensive humor and sarcasm, is one of television's most beloved characters.
bcfe8b49: In which season do Monica and Chandler reveal their secret relationship?
Monica and Chandler get together at the end of season 4. Their long-hidden relationship comes out in the middle of season 5, after Phoebe spots them through the window.
c7ab7db0: What is Joey's famous pick-up line?
“How you doin'?” is Joey's signature pick-up line. Delivered with a charming smile, it has become one of the most quoted lines in American pop culture.
b9053256: What is the name of Ross's ex-wife who comes out as a lesbian?
Carol Willick is Ross's first wife. She comes out as a lesbian and begins a relationship with Susan Bunch, and Ross has to accept that their son Ben will be raised by Carol and Susan.
9d26e5a2: Which apartment do Joey and Chandler live in?
After a renumbering during the series, Joey and Chandler's apartment is number 19, across the hall from Monica's, number 20.
4827be22: What do Joey and Chandler win in a bet against Monica and Rachel?
In “The One with the Embryos”, the girls bet their apartment against Joey and Chandler's in a trivia game, and lose. The guys move into the big apartment and the girls take the small one.
5c9d6b1d: What is the name of the actress who plays Monica in Friends?
Courteney Cox plays Monica Geller. She is the only one of the six main actors never nominated for an Emmy for Friends, which fans considered unfair.
a83d2d67: In which episode do Ross and Rachel accidentally get married in Las Vegas?
The One Where Everyone Finds Out
“The One in Vegas” (season 5 finale): Ross and Rachel, drunk in Las Vegas, get married in a wedding chapel. They then have to file for divorce, adding a third marriage to Ross's collection.
2747a823: What are the names of the twins adopted by Monica and Chandler?
Monica and Chandler expected to adopt one baby, but Erica, the birth mother, has twins. They name them Jack and Erica, then move to the suburbs of New York.
88f8f74e: Which misspelled name appears on the TV Guide delivered to Chandler?
Chandler's TV Guide arrives addressed to “Miss Chanandler Bong”, a mistake that becomes a running gag.
eda9e91a: David Schwimmer plays Ross Geller, a paleontologist who teaches at a university. He is Monica's older brother.
963eef11: What is the name of Joey's big white dog statue?
Pat is the white ceramic dog statue that Joey adores and keeps in the apartment.
34e377ba: Which actress plays Rachel Green in Friends?
Jennifer Aniston plays Rachel Green. Her “Rachel” haircut became the most requested of the 1990s, and she won an Emmy Award for the role.
0c22f928: Which character loves the Thanksgiving leftover turkey sandwich?
Ross loves the “Moist Maker”, his Thanksgiving leftover sandwich. When a coworker eats it at the office, he throws a memorable fit.
6abe1013: Which major fashion brand does Rachel work for in the later seasons?
Rachel works at Ralph Lauren. At the end of the series, she gets an offer from Louis Vuitton in Paris.
231d1898: In which building do Monica and Rachel live in the early seasons?
The building seen on screen is at 90 Bedford Street in Greenwich Village, Manhattan: it really exists and has become a tourist pilgrimage site. The apartment interior is a studio set.
78a11fd8: Which recurring Friends character is Chandler's flamboyant mother?
Nora Tyler Bing, played by Morgan Fairchild, is Chandler's mother, a flamboyant novelist. She embarrasses her son by kissing Ross.
75e707d4: What is Joey's iconic line about food?
“JOEY DOESN'T SHARE FOOD!” is one of the series' most iconic lines: Joey is absolutely uncompromising about sharing food. Not even his date can touch his plate.
71820b31: What is the name of the cast reunion special aired in 2021?
The One Where They Say Goodbye
Friends: The Reunion (2021, HBO Max) brings the original cast back together: not a scripted episode but an unscripted special with the six main actors, interviews, recreated sets and famous fans.
55d2a0fa: How many Emmy Awards did Friends win in total?
Friends won 6 Emmy Awards over its 10 seasons, including Outstanding Comedy Series in 2002, from 62 nominations.
55ded4f3: What do Joey and Chandler call their duck?
Joey and Chandler adopt a chick and then a duck, which they simply call “the Chick” and “the Duck”.
0cb55e19: What is the name of the stuffed toy Joey treasures?
Hugsy is Joey's stuffed penguin, which he refuses to give up, even when Emma, Ross and Rachel's daughter, takes a liking to it.
3d59ea81: What is Monica's recurring issue with cleanliness and order?
She is obsessively clean and tidy
Monica is obsessed with cleanliness and order. The slightest mess stresses her out, which makes her the target of many of her friends' jokes.
4b2cf6f8: What kind of performance does Phoebe give at Central Perk?
Guitar sets of her own absurd original songs
Phoebe plays guitar and sings her own creations at Central Perk, absurd and sincere songs like “Smelly Cat”. Her limited talent and boundless enthusiasm make for a lovable running gag.
0fc738af: What is the name of the agent who manages Joey's career?
Estelle Leonard is Joey's aging and not very professional agent. She misses opportunities, mixes up appointments and eventually dies off-screen in season 10.
550330e5: Which actor plays Ross and Monica's father?
Elliott Gould plays Jack Geller, Ross and Monica's father. His wife Judy is played by Christina Pickles.
6987fc43: What is the name of the character played by Tom Selleck, Monica's forbidden love?
Richard Burke is the ophthalmologist played by Tom Selleck, a family friend and Monica's forbidden love because of their age gap (he is her father's friend).
7d86f01b: In which season of Friends is Emma, Ross and Rachel's daughter, born?
Emma is born in season 8, after a night Ross and Rachel spent together. Her birth is a major emotional turning point in the series.
d1fdb8d1: Which strange roommate does Chandler live with when Joey moves out in season 2?
When Joey moves out to live alone, Chandler ends up with Eddie, played by Adam Goldberg, an increasingly creepy roommate.
faa9fc03: What is the name of Ross's monkey that he eventually has to give to a zoo?
Marcel, Ross's capuchin, ends up causing him too much trouble. Ross hands him over to the San Diego Zoo.
c1ef3400: What is the name of the restaurant that gives Monica her first real head chef job?
Monica becomes head chef at Alessandro's, an Italian restaurant whose food she had panned in a review.
2c113264: What is Phoebe Buffay's main source of income?
Phoebe is a licensed masseuse who works at a massage parlor and makes house calls. Her music at Central Perk is not her living.
4db3af52: What is the name of Phoebe's birth mother, with whom she reconnects in the series?
Phoebe discovers that her birth mother is Phoebe Abbott, a friend of her parents who shares her first name.
6a91f6ad: To which city is Rachel supposed to move for work at the end of the series?
Rachel gets a job offer in Paris in the series finale, the final dilemma for Ross, who has to decide whether to ask her to stay.
96cdd200: What is the last line of dialogue in the final episode of Friends?
Rachel suggests going for one last cup of coffee, and Chandler replies “Where?”, a wink at Central Perk just downstairs.
